original_description: Kolbo.AI helps users create and edit images, video, music, speech, sound, and 3D assets, then organize the results in projects, documents, review spaces, and a synchronized media library.
summary_ja: 画像・動画・音楽・音声・3D素材を作成・編集し、プロジェクトやメディアライブラリで整理する。
limitations: スキルの説明では動画編集／FFmpegやモーショングラフィックスは対象外とされる。メイン説明の動画の作成・編集との具体的な範囲は要確認。
実動作・料金・品質・一覧本体との名称照合は未検証。
skill_description_original: Generate, edit, or analyze creative media via the Kolbo AI MCP server: images (GPT Image, Nano Banana, Flux), video (Seedance, Veo, Kling, Hailuo), music (Suno), TTS (ElevenLabs), 3D, transcription, Visual DNA (character consistency), Marketing Studio (UGC + DTC ads + product photoshoot + marketplace cards), Creative Director (multi-scene batches), HTML artifact publishing (presentations, landing pages, dashboards), AI Docs (project documents you author and share). Use when the user wants to generate, create, make, edit, animate, or transcribe media: images, video, music, voice/TTS, sound effects, 3D models, UGC or TV-spot ads, product / lifestyle / hero shots, Amazon or marketplace listings, presentations, landing pages, or dashboards; to reuse a character or brand (Visual DNA, brand kits); or to save a written plan / brief / script / research into a Kolbo project (AI Docs). NOT for: video editing / FFmpeg (use video-production), motion graphics (use remotion-best-practices), code editing, or general chat.
